metadata.title: Team — Webkarigor
metadata.description: Meet the handpicked team behind Webkarigor — designers, engineers, and product thinkers building digital products that perform.

intro: A small, focused team building products with craft, clarity, and care — turning ideas into digital experiences that help businesses grow.

members.name: Sarah Ahmed
members.bio: I shape how products feel in people's hands — from first sketch to polished UI. Clarity, craft, and a little obsession with the details that make software feel effortless.

members.name: Rakib Hasan
members.bio: I lead the engineering side of builds that need to ship clean and scale well. Good architecture, honest timelines, and code the next person on the team can actually love.

members.name: Nadia Rahman
members.bio: I talk to users so we don't guess. Interviews, tests, and synthesis that turn messy feedback into decisions the whole team can move on.

members.name: Arif Khan
members.bio: I help brands find a sharper story — positioning, voice, and the through-line that makes every touchpoint feel like the same company.

members.name: Farhan Islam
members.bio: I started Webkarigor to build digital products that actually perform for businesses. Strategy, delivery, and making sure the team has what they need to do their best work.

members.name: Lima Chowdhury
members.bio: I design systems and screens that stay consistent under pressure. Design ops, interaction detail, and the kind of polish that shows up when you use the product every day.

members.name: Imran Hossain
members.bio: Frontend to backend — I like shipping end-to-end features that feel fast and hold up. Clean APIs, solid UI, and fewer surprises in production.

members.name: Tania Akter
members.bio: I look after how Webkarigor shows up in the world — visual language, campaigns, and the small cues that make a brand feel intentional.

members.name: Sabbir Ahmed
members.bio: I keep projects moving without the chaos. Clear scopes, honest updates, and making sure clients and makers stay aligned from kickoff to launch.

members.name: Nushrat Jahan
members.bio: I add motion that earns its place — transitions, micro-interactions, and branded moments that make the product feel alive without getting in the way.

members.name: Karim Ullah
members.bio: I build the systems under the UI — reliable APIs, data models, and performance work that users never notice until something's missing.

members.name: Meherin Sultana
members.bio: I craft visual identity that holds across decks, sites, and product. Type, color, and layout with enough personality to stand out and enough restraint to last.
